gui.liasmediaplayer.config.title: Lia's Media Player Options
Height the video is decoded at. Lower is lighter on the CPU and on the network; higher is sharper.
config.liasmediaplayer.max_pinned_images: How many images can stay pinned on screen at once. The oldest is closed when a new one opens.
config.liasmediaplayer.max_video_windows: How many video players can be open at once. Further links are queued in an existing player instead.
config.liasmediaplayer.max_audio_windows: How many audio bars can be open at once. Further links are queued in an existing bar instead.
config.liasmediaplayer.max_gif_frames.de: Frames decoded from a GIF. Longer GIFs are cut off at this many frames rather than being refused.
config.liasmediaplayer.max_image_cache_e: How many decoded images are kept in memory for instant re-display.
config.liasmediaplayer.frame_queue_capac: Decoded video frames buffered ahead of playback. More absorbs stutter; each frame costs memory.
Warning: Increasing this value will consume more memory!
config.liasmediaplayer.max_image_cache_m: Memory the image cache may use. Entries are dropped oldest first once it is reached.
config.liasmediaplayer.yt_dlp_timeout.de: How long to wait for yt-dlp to resolve a link before giving up on it.
config.liasmediaplayer.default_window_po: Where a new player appears. Centred windows cascade so they do not land on top of each other.

Which links from chat become playable. OFF plays anything recognised, BLOCKLIST refuses the blocked domains, ALLOWLIST accepts only the allowed ones.
config.liasmediaplayer.blocked_domains.d: Comma-separated hosts to refuse, sub-domains included (for example: example.com, i.redd.it). Used when the filter is set to BLOCKLIST.
config.liasmediaplayer.allowed_domains.d: Comma-separated hosts to accept, sub-domains included. Used when the filter is set to ALLOWLIST; empty means nothing is accepted.
config.liasmediaplayer.blocked_senders.d: Comma-separated player names whose links are never made playable. Matches anywhere in the name shown in chat, so a rank prefix does not defeat it.

error.liasmediaplayer.cause.tool_missing: yt-dlp or ffmpeg could not be found or downloaded. Check your connection, then update the tools.
error.liasmediaplayer.cause.extractor_ou: The site changed and this yt-dlp no longer understands it. Updating the tools usually fixes it.
error.liasmediaplayer.cause.age_restrict: This one can only be watched signed in, which the mod does not do. Open it in your browser.
error.liasmediaplayer.cause.sign_in.hint: The site is asking for an account or a bot check. Open the link in your browser.
error.liasmediaplayer.cause.private.hint: Only its owner can watch this one.
The uploader has not made this available where you are.
error.liasmediaplayer.cause.live_not_sta: This is a premiere or a scheduled stream. Try again once it is live.
It was removed, or the link points at nothing playable.
error.liasmediaplayer.cause.timeout.hint: The site took too long to answer. Retry, or raise the yt-dlp timeout in the settings.
error.liasmediaplayer.cause.not_found.hi: The link points at a file that is no longer there.
error.liasmediaplayer.cause.link_expired: The stream link has expired or the host refused it. Retrying resolves a fresh one.
error.liasmediaplayer.cause.network.hint: The host could not be reached. Check your connection, then retry.
error.liasmediaplayer.cause.unsupported_: ffmpeg cannot read this stream. Updating the tools may add support for it.
error.liasmediaplayer.cause.decode_faile: ffmpeg stopped part-way through. Retry; if it keeps happening, update the tools.
error.liasmediaplayer.cause.unknown.hint: The tools reported the message below. Retry, or update the tools.
gui.liasmediaplayer.toast.outdated: yt-dlp is out of date - update it in the settings
gui.liasmediaplayer.toast.update_failed: Could not update the media tools
config.liasmediaplayer.auto_update_tools: Replaces yt-dlp at launch when the installed one is more than 30 days old. YouTube breaks older versions regularly.
